justification: Total sample 354 months (1996-12-31 to 2026-05-29). Three-period design per ECON-OOS4: IS=212 months (ends 2014-07-31), OOS=71 months (2014-08-29 to 2020-06-30), Holdout=71 months (2020-07-31 to 2026-05-29). GFC 2008-09 falls in-sample providing stress-episode coverage for HMM. COVID-2020 falls in holdout providing out-of-sample stress validation. Holdout >= 24 months: satisfied (71 months >> 24 floor). Full 354-month dataset resolves prior FRED licensing constraint (35 obs).
